values.note: First-come, first-served. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out before 11 am. Six people, two vehicles and one RV per site. Generators 8-10 am and 5-7 pm.

sites.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/camping (Wilcox: Sites 46; 'Best suited for motorhomes and trailers under 8.2 metres (27 feet)'), read 2026-11-10

note: On the Icefields Parkway 3 km south of the Columbia Icefield, in forest on a slope above the road: sites sit in rows stepping up the hill. Kitchen shelters and food lockers. --Claude
summary: Keep. 2026 season June 10 - Sep 28 confirmed, 46 first-come primitive sites; added the C$35.75 rate, the 27-ft limit and the dump station shown on the campground map. Pin sits on the loops.
